This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[truncated cube]]s, formed by [[Truncation (geometry)|truncating]] each of the cubes in the [[compound of five cubes|compound of 5 cubes]]. It is also called the truncated rhombihedron.

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the cyclic permutations of

: (±(2+{{radic|2}}), ±{{radic|2}}, ±(2+{{radic|2}}))
: (±τ, ±(τ<sup>−1</sup>+τ<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|2}}), ±(2τ−1+τ{{radic|2}}))
: (±1, ±(τ<sup>−2</sup>−τ<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|2}}), ±(τ<sup>2</sup>+τ{{radic|2}}))
: (±(1+{{radic|2}}), ±(−τ<sup>−2</sup>−{{radic|2}}), ±(τ<sup>2</sup>+{{radic|2}}))
: (±(τ+τ{{radic|2}}), ±(−τ<sup>−1</sup>), ±(2τ−1+τ<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|2}}))

where τ = (1+{{radic|5}})/2 is the [[golden ratio]] (sometimes written φ).
